name: 狄昂
src: 月银纪史诗/第二歌_镜中石瞳.md:242
who: Dion, a human boy of the net-island, seventeen, a fisherman's son who has the face of seventeen for ever: about 172 cm, slim, upright and stiff-backed, wholly covered by his clothes. Black hair that the sea wind keeps tousled, the ends sun-faded to chestnut, showing a faint gold sheen when it rains. Thick straight dark eyebrows; stormy slate-blue eyes like the sky before a thunderstorm, with a little gold pressed into the grey, that size up people as if judging the depth of a sea. A small old scar under the chin from a fish hook. Face flushed by sea wind; he rarely smiles, and when he does it is a boy's smile. Hands and fingers thick with net-pulling calluses. On his back a round bronze shield polished like still water. Few words, proud, never looks back.
palette: storm slate blue, polished bronze, wet black with a gold sheen, faded sail-cloth grey, seal-skin brown
casual: His fisher clothes: a faded hemp tunic, over it a sleeveless seal-skin vest, a length of old net rope tied round the waist as a belt, hemp trousers, plaited sea-grass shoes laced up the ankle with one grey feather sewn into each heel; his mother's woven fishing net slung diagonally from his shoulder; a short single-edged blade with a slightly bowed back, its edge a single claw of a burrowing dragon, at his belt on the left; on his back the round bronze shield polished like a still lake, its face turned outward, a pair of closed stone eyes set in its boss. He stands very straight, chin up, the arms at his sides.
private: Resting after the day's work: the vest and the shield off, a long-sleeved hemp tunic closed at the throat, hemp trousers, soft grass shoes, the net folded over one forearm, the tousled hair damp from the sea air. He mends a knot with his thick fingers and does not look at the viewer; a stern, calm look.
battle: Walking backwards toward danger: the hemp tunic under the seal-skin vest, leather bracers, the net rope belt cinched tight, laced grass shoes. He holds the round bronze shield up before his chest with its polished face toward himself so that he looks only into it, never at the foe; the claw-edged blade is drawn low in his right hand; his body is turned away, the mouth set tight, the brow drawn together.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: he stands side-on with his face turned away, holding the large round bronze shield up in both hands in front of his chest, steady and braced, the feet planted, the mouth closed, a hard, determined look.
formal: At a long-hall feast on the island: a clean dark blue wool tunic belted with the net rope, a short grey cloak pinned at the left shoulder with a plain bronze pin, a white linen shirt collar showing, polished grass shoes, the bronze shield worn on his back freshly rubbed. He stands stiffly, hands at his sides, a proud, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait in a storm, the face a little turned, the slate-blue eyes with a touch of gold serious and wide open, the mouth closed. Cold storm light from the left, rain streaking down, a faint gold sheen in the wet black hair. Foreground blur: raindrops and a pale flash of lightning far off. The round bronze shield rises behind his shoulder.

name: 安朵
src: 月银纪史诗/第二歌_镜中石瞳.md:299
who: Andor, a human fish-gutter from a village by the reef, eighteen years old: about 166 cm, a diving swimmer's body, strong shoulders and back, a slim waist and long legs, able to dive to the reef floor on one breath. Seaweed-green long hair, flat against her back when wet and a wild tangle when dry, pinned up carelessly with a fish-bone pin with a knife hidden in it. Clear shallow-sea blue eyes slanting up at the outer corners, fierce as a fish just out of the water. Honey-brown skin from the sea wind, a scatter of salt-grain freckles over the nose and cheekbones. Both wrists carry a ring of red rust mark from the chains, which she does not hide. A shark's tooth she pulled herself hangs at her neck. Sharp-tongued, bold and rebellious.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young woman's face of about eighteen, clear shallow-sea blue eyes with outer corners that lift, a thin tapering dark-green upper lash line, thin strong eyebrows, a scatter of small freckles across the nose and cheekbones, a mouth with a sharp little smirk showing ordinary teeth; skin shadows a warm pink-orange.
build: 166 cm, a swimmer's build: strong shoulders and back, firm arms, a D-cup, a narrow waist and long legs with gently rounded hips.
palette: seaweed green, shallow-sea blue, honey skin, salt white, rust red, bone ivory
casual: Her fishing-village clothes: a knee-length sleeveless hemp fisher's dress with the sleeves torn off, both arms bare and brown from the sea wind and the red rust rings plainly showing at both wrists; a gutting knife and a small leather pouch of salt at the belt; the shark's tooth on a cord at her neck; the green hair pinned up with the fish-bone pin; bare feet. She stands with her chin raised, a cheeky smirk.
private: Home after the day's catch: a long-sleeved, high-collared undyed linen dress to the shins, soft grass shoes, the green hair loose and damp over one shoulder, the shark's tooth at her neck. She mends a net across her lap with brisk fingers; a lazy cheeky closed-mouth smile.
battle: Ready to dive into the surf and fight: a short hemp fisher's tunic belted tight over fitted hemp leggings, leather bracers over both wrists, the strip of white linen cut from her sacrifice robe tied round one leg, the green hair bound up with the fish-bone pin. She holds the long gutting knife low in her right hand, blade turned out, and a short boat-hook in her left; a fierce, sharp look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: crouched a little and ready to spring, the gutting knife held low in her right hand and the left hand out for balance, the feet planted wide, a fierce sharp look, the mouth closed.
formal: On the day she was taken to the reef: a long white hemp sacrificial robe with long sleeves, the hem torn off one side and tied round her leg as a strip, a rope sash, the green hair combed straight, the shark's tooth on its cord. The red rust rings show at her wrists. She stands very straight and defiant.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the clear blue eyes looking straight at the viewer, bold and amused, a sharp little closed-mouth smirk. Bright cold sea light from one side, a warm low sun on the other. Foreground blur: spray of sea water and the soft shape of a net. The shark's tooth glints at her neck and the fish-bone pin shows in her green hair.

name: 瑟拉
src: 月银纪史诗/第二歌_镜中石瞳.md:357
who: Sera, a human dove-keeper girl of the pigeon city, sixteen years old, petite and slight, about 155 cm, wholly covered by her clothes. Silver-white hair as white as dust on stone, falling all the way to her ankles, loosely tied at the back with a cord plaited from dove feathers. Pale milky grey eyes that look clouded and unfocused, never at a person's face but toward the side the voice comes from; white eyelashes; a very pale face that has lived in the shadow of stone and never seen the sun. A grey dove always perches on her shoulder. At her waist hangs a string of small pebbles collected from every street of the city; she knows each street by touch. Quiet, still, and dreamlike, like a statue until she tilts her head.
face: FACE, as in the references: a girl's small pale face, medium gently slanted milky pale-grey eyes with a clouded, unfocused look, open, white lashes and a thin white upper lash line, thin white eyebrows, a tiny nose, a small closed mouth; very pale skin with almost no shading, shadows a soft cool grey-pink.
palette: silver white, dove grey, pale stone, milk-grey eyes, soft feather cream
casual: Her dove-keeper clothes: a long dove-grey old cloth dress to the ankles with long sleeves and a round neckline closed at the throat, a ring of dove feathers stitched around the hem, a string of small pebbles hanging at her waist; barefoot, she says the stones tell her the way. A grey dove sits on her left shoulder (on the viewer's right when they face us). The silver-white hair is tied loosely at the back with a feather-plaited cord. She stands very still, her head a little tilted.
private: At home among the dovecote: a plain long-sleeved, high-necked grey wool dress to the shins, a thick undyed shawl over the shoulders, soft felt slippers, the long silver hair loose over one shoulder; a grey dove sits in her cupped hands. A quiet, dreamy closed-mouth smile.
battle: Standing her ground in the street: the dove-grey dress belted with a leather strap, a grey wool cloak closed at the throat, soft leather boots, the pebble string tied close at her waist, the long hair braided and wound round her head. She holds out one arm with the grey dove ready to fly from her wrist and the other hand flat against a wall; a calm, unafraid look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, standing steady and calm with the feet planted, one arm held out to launch the grey dove from her wrist and the other hand open at her side, the pale eyes wide open, the mouth closed.
formal: At the city's evening gathering: a straight-cut dove-grey coarse cloth dress to the ankles with long sleeves, a plaited rope tied at the waist, the neck closed with a single carved bone pin, and the ring of white dove feathers still stitched round the hem, stirring faintly as if a breeze touched them. The pebble string is tucked away, one white dove feather pinned at the chest, soft shoes. She stands with her hands folded, a quiet, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly to one side, the pale milky eyes open and gazing just past the viewer, the mouth closed. Soft cool dawn light from one side, a faint warm gold line on the other. The grey dove on her shoulder and the long silver hair fill the frame. Foreground blur: drifting grey feathers.

name: 埃纳尔
src: 月银纪史诗/第二歌_镜中石瞳.md:414
who: Einar, a human long-hall singer, eighteen years old, the island lord's son: slim, about 179 cm, a narrow-shouldered, long-fingered young man who has never hauled a net, clearly a grown young man and not a child. A thick mass of golden curls piled up like sun-dried wheat. Bright warm amber eyes that look as if they are always laughing. Fair skin, an even handsome face, one dimple on the left cheek when he smiles. He is always smiling, so well that nobody can tell what he is thinking. Ten long soft fingers used to plucking strings. A charming, easy, hard-to-read air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a handsome young man's face of about eighteen, warm bright amber eyes gently slanted, a thin tapering gold upper lash line, straight gold eyebrows, a small straight nose, a smile with one dimple on the left cheek (on the viewer's right when they face us), a neat chin; clean skin with very little shading, shadows a soft warm pink.
palette: wheat gold, amber, indigo blue wool, driftwood brown, silver and bright gold accents
casual: His singer's clothes: an indigo-blue wool cloak pinned on the left shoulder (on the viewer's right when they face us) with a gold brooch cast as a fish biting its own tail, over a fine linen robe to the knee with long sleeves, a silver arm ring on the right wrist, soft dark trousers, leather shoes; in the crook of his arm a small upright harp whose body is a length of driftwood and whose strings are twisted whale sinew. He smiles his easy, charming smile.
private: Idling by the long-hall fire: the cloak off and thrown over a bench, a long-sleeved cream linen shirt with the collar open one button, soft trousers, house shoes, the silver arm ring still on the right wrist; he plucks idly at the small harp. A lazy dimpled smile.
battle: Out of his depth but standing his ground: the indigo wool cloak pinned tight over a quilted linen jerkin, leather bracers, boots; he grips the small driftwood harp in his left hand like a shield, and in his right a plain borrowed short sword held awkwardly low; the smile gone for once, the mouth set.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, planted and braced with the shoulders squared, the small driftwood harp held up in the left hand and a short sword held low in the right, the smile gone, a worried but determined look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the nine-night feast in the long hall: a rich indigo wool cloak with a gold fish-brooch at the left shoulder, a pale blue silk-trimmed linen robe, both silver arm rings, the golden curls oiled and shining. He holds the harp ready to play and stands with a polished showman's smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the warm amber eyes looking straight at the viewer, bright and unreadable, a charming smile with the single dimple. Warm gold hearth light from the right, cool sea-blue light from the left. Foreground blur: the soft glint of harp strings and drifting sparks. The indigo cloak with the gold fish brooch shows at the shoulder.

name: 达娜厄
src: 月银纪史诗/第二歌_镜中石瞳.md:619
who: Danae, a human woman in her early thirties, a king's daughter once shut in a bronze tower and now a net-mender on a fishing island: about 164 cm, slender and worn lean by hard work, so graceful that the island lord cannot sleep. Straight black hair with several early white strands, tied back plainly at the nape. Eyes of the same stormy slate-blue as the sky before a thunderstorm, steady and calm. Fair skin; the fingers and palms cut all over with net-mending lines. She does not smile, not because she cannot, but because a smile here brings someone knocking. Polite, firm, closes doors loudly. The early white strands must be clearly drawn in every panel: several distinct white threads streak the black hair at both temples and one thin white lock runs back from the front hairline, plainly visible against the black.
face: FACE, as in the references: a quiet woman's face of about thirty-two, calm slightly slanted stormy slate-blue eyes with a long thin dark upper lash line, straight thin dark eyebrows, a straight nose, a closed mouth held level, faint lines at the corners of the eyes; fair skin, shadows a soft cool pink.
build: 164 cm, slender and wiry from work: narrow shoulders, strong thin arms, a small waist, an upright carriage, rough work-worn hands.
palette: black hair with white strands, storm slate blue, undyed linen, driftwood brown, net-rope grey
casual: Her island clothes: a plain long undyed hemp dress to the ankles with long sleeves rolled to the forearm, a coarse grey apron tied over it, a wool shawl crossed over the shoulders, a bone net needle and a small knife at the belt, soft leather shoes; a half-mended fishing net held over one forearm. She stands upright and composed, the face calm.
private: At home in the evening: the apron and shawl off, a long-sleeved, high-necked dark wool dress to the shins, house shoes, the black-and-white hair loosened over one shoulder; she holds a mug in both work-cut hands. A tired, steady, closed-mouth look.
battle: Standing in a doorway against a visitor: the grey apron cinched tight over the hemp dress, the shawl pinned, sleeves rolled up, sturdy shoes; she holds a heavy wooden net-mending shuttle in her right hand like a short club, her chin raised, her left hand flat against the door frame; a cold, level look, the mouth shut.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, standing upright and braced with the feet planted, a heavy wooden net shuttle held low in the right hand and the left hand open at her side, a cold, level look, the mouth closed.
formal: As a guest at the island lord's feast, grudgingly: a long dark blue wool gown with long sleeves and a high plain collar, a pinned white linen kerchief at the throat, the hair braided and pinned up neatly, a plain bone pin; no jewellery. She stands very straight, unsmiling.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the slate-blue eyes looking straight at the viewer, calm and wary, the mouth closed. Cold grey sea light from one side, a thin warm lamp light on the other. Foreground blur: net cords hanging across the lens and a few drops of rain. A few white strands show in the black hair.
